en: Vintage sepia portrait of a young woman standing indoors in front of a painted studio backdrop. She wears a patterned headscarf, a dark buttoned jacket and a long patterned skirt over a checked underskirt, with dark stockings and shoes. Her left hand rests on her hip and her right hand rests on an ornate side table with a vase of white flowers. The reverse side is blank except for guide lines for address and a few handwritten notes and a label in one corner.
